# DataForge v0.6.2

## Security / product
- Delivery `destinationPath` jailed under `data/exports/delivery`
- `recordHistory` defaults **false** (matches UI opt-in)

## UI
- 508: skip link, focus-visible, dialog focus trap
- Inline value edit (no browser prompts); name create bar
- Tabular Wide / Tall / Transpose for CSV/TXT/XLSX samples

## Windows binary
1. Download **DataForge-v0.6.2-windows-x64.zip**
2. Extract whole folder (exe + `_internal`)
3. Run **DataForge.exe** → http://127.0.0.1:8765/
